//AzureAd: Entra ID sign-in. Real values belong in appsettings.Production.json, which is gitignored - never here. See docs/entra-id-setup.md.
//DigitalCard: Reading a visitor's Emirates ID from the camera, for a visitor who carries the card on a phone. The camera reads continuously - there is no shutter - and either side will do: the three lines on the back fill every field, the printed number on the front fills the ID number alone. Recognition runs in the browser on Tesseract/WebAssembly - free, and nothing to install on the server. Off by default. EngineBaseUrl and TrainedDataUrl point at public CDNs; host the files under wwwroot and point these at /lib/tesseract on a network that blocks them. Language is the Tesseract model: "eng" is the default because it is what the public host serves, but a model trained on OCR-B alone is smaller and better at this - see README.

Toolkit.//Mode: InProcess (reader on this machine), Agent (reader on the desk, ICP agent there) or Off (typed in). See docs/deployment.md.
Toolkit.//: Must contain config_li and config_ag. Set this to your machine's path.
Toolkit.//NativeDirectory: Only needed if the native toolkit DLLs are not beside the app; the build copies them there.
Toolkit.//Agent: Mode=Agent only. TrustedSignerThumbprints is the control that makes a browser-supplied read trustworthy - see docs/deployment.md.
